verdict.rationale: Shopify Agentic Commerce is the server side of agent commerce. It exposes UCP-compliant MCP servers (Catalog, Cart, Checkout, Order) plus a CLI that external AI agents call. It is not an MCP host or agent that consumes third-party MCP servers, so the MCP-client story is the wrong role for this product type. Its own MCP servers cannot be credited toward a client-side capability.
